purpose: Compare F5-P/F5-R with simple post-detection fusion on identical input (box-corrected .05 crop pool)

baselines.B2: greedy confidence-ordered cross-camera ray NMS: same-camera compatible IoU>=0.5 suppressed; other-camera compatible detection with centre-ray angle<=theta joins as member (one per camera)
baselines.B3: B2 groups kept only with >=2 supporting cameras
baselines.B3p: B2 groups kept if >=2 cameras OR single-view conf>=tau_s

selection: development only: max recall s.t. P>=0.90; else null + best-F1 point; locked before full/guard+late replay
rays: native-box centre rays in the shared IMU frame (checked: matched F5-P members median 0.5-1.5 deg)
